name: MUD World Engine
description: Standardized spatial MUD engine using a static Base Lorebook + sparse chat_data coordinate delta overlay. Provides deterministic ASCII mini-maps, swipe-safe movement, driver-callable move/look tools, response-tag state updates, and optional location images.
llm_instructions: Move or inspect the current MUD world cell. Args: action ('move' or 'look'), dir (N, S, E, W, IN, OUT for move), target (object or npc id for look). Example: <call:mud_world_engine action="move" dir="E" />
